svg.title: Updated V2 architecture
svg.desc: Offline index and online pipeline, with updated steps marked

g.text: Splits by subject, lists named products
Drug names only from named products
Symptom mode: BM25 + FAISS + RRF, top 60
Strict prompt, sentence verified by code
Top-2 chunk score, cap 3 specific, 10 list
Chosen plus best-scoring, max 6 per drug
Once per drug, LLM copies, code verifies

svg.text: Every LLM call retries on HTTP 500, waits 1 s
